material_definitions: The Li4-xGe1-xPxS4 solid solution is formed through aliovalent substitution of a pentavalent element (P) for the tetravalent M cation (Ge) in the Li4MS4 thio-LISICON structure.
The resulting compounds have mixed compositions (either lithium excess or deficient) which impact transport properties.
This specific solid solution is referenced as resulting in the highest ionic conductivity among these specific solid electrolytes.
warnings: Temperature (25 Celsius) is inferred as standard room temperature, typical for reporting 'highest ionic conductivity' values from cited literature.

material_definitions: Solid solutions within Li4Ge(1-x)Sn(x)S(4-nu)Se(nu) were synthesized to study ionic mobility in the thio-LISICON family.
All compounds crystallize in the orthorhombic Pnma space group (no. 62).
The series involves isovalent substitutions of Ge by Sn and S by Se, resulting in a linear increase of lattice volume.
Ionic transport was characterized using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy between 283 K and 333 K.
warnings: Value cited from Kaib et al. for comparison.
Temperature is specified as Room Temperature.
